Name: Asking questions
Purpose: Teach the user how to form and ask questions in the present simple tense.

Name: Talking about habits
Purpose: Teach the user how to talk about habits and routines, using the present simple and adverbs of frequency.

Name: Stating facts
Purpose: Teach the user how to state facts and use the present simple to describe general truths.

Name: Expressing contrast
Purpose: Teach the user how to express contrast and differences between ideas, objects, or situations.

Name: Slang & colloquialisms
Purpose: Expose the user to informal language, slang, and colloquial expressions used in everyday conversations.

Name: Poetic register
Purpose: Introduce the user to figurative language, imagery, and expressive forms used in poetry and literature.

Name: Culture
Purpose: Introduce the user to cultural norms, values, etiquette, celebrations, and regional practices associated with the target language.

Name: Humour
Purpose: Teach the user about humour, including jokes, puns, and culturally specific references.

Name: Language & linguistics
Purpose: Introduce the user to the study of language, including its structure, use, and the various languages spoken around the world.

Name: Quotes & sayings
Purpose: Teach well-known quotes, sayings, and proverbs in the target language, including their meanings, cultural context, and appropriate usage.

Name: Pop culture
Purpose: Teach the user about popular culture, including contemporary media, trends, and cultural phenomena.

Name: Feelings & emotions
Purpose: Teach the user vocabulary for expressing basic feelings and emotions, and forming adjectival expressions.

Name: Daily life
Purpose: Teach the user to describe daily activities and routines using the present simple tense.

Name: Education
Purpose: Teach the user vocabulary and expressions related to educational settings, studying, and academic subjects.

Name: Food
Purpose: Teach the user vocabulary for common foods and expressions for discussing preferences and dietary restrictions.

Name: Groceries
Purpose: Teach grocery items, quantities, packaging, prices, shopping requests, and locating products in a store or market.

Name: Dining out
Purpose: Teach reading menus, ordering politely, asking about dishes, handling dietary needs, paying, and discussing service.

Name: Numbers
Purpose: Teach the user to recognize and use numbers in order to count, ask about quantity, and discuss prices.

Name: Colors
Purpose: Teach the user to recognize and name common colors and use them naturally to describe objects in the target language.

Name: Telling time
Purpose: Teach the user how to ask for and tell the time, discuss schedules, and use natural time expressions in the target language.

Name: Singular subject pronouns (I / you / he / she)
Purpose: Teach the user the target language's singular subject pronouns, when they may be omitted, and how they behave in a sentence.

Name: Present tense
Purpose: Teach the user how to describe habitual actions and universal truths using the present simple tense.

Name: Possessive pronouns & qualifiers
Purpose: Teach the user to express ownership and relationships with possessive pronouns and qualifiers.

Name: Have / possess
Purpose: Teach the user how to use the verb 'have' to indicate possession and in expressions of age.

Name: Need
Purpose: Teach the user how to express needs and requirements using the verb 'need'.

Name: Want
Purpose: Teach the user how to express desires and wants using the verb 'want'.

Name: Like
Purpose: Teach the user how to express preferences and likes using the verb 'like'.

Name: Negation
Purpose: Teach the user how to form negative sentences and negate verbs in the present simple tense.

Name: Present continuous
Purpose: Teach the user how to describe ongoing actions and current activities using the present continuous tense.

Name: Adjectives
Purpose: Teach the user how to use adjectives to describe people, objects, and experiences.

Name: Imperative
Purpose: Teach the user how to use the imperative mood to give commands, make requests, and offer invitations.

Name: Verbs of movement
Purpose: Teach the user vocabulary and expressions related to movement and common verbs of motion.

Name: Frequency adverbs
Purpose: Teach the user how to use adverbs of frequency to describe how often they do activities.

Name: Manner adverbs
Purpose: Teach the user how to use adverbs of manner to describe how actions are performed.

Name: Comparisons
Purpose: Teach the user how to make comparisons between people, objects, and actions, using comparative and superlative forms.

Name: Can
Purpose: Teach the user how to use the modal verb 'can' to express ability, possibility, and permission.

Name: Must
Purpose: Teach the user how to use the modal verb 'must' to express obligation and necessity.

Name: May
Purpose: Teach the user how to use the modal verb 'may' to express possibility and make polite requests.

Name: Should
Purpose: Teach the user how to use the modal verb 'should' to give advice and make recommendations.

Name: Seem
Purpose: Teach the user how to use the verb 'seem' to describe appearances and perceptions.

Name: Past tense
Purpose: Teach the user how to describe past events and actions using the past simple tense.

Name: Future tense
Purpose: Teach the user how to talk about future plans and predictions using the going to-future and present continuous.

Name: Conditionals
Purpose: Teach the user how to use conditional sentences to express real and hypothetical situations.

Name: Past perfect
Purpose: Teach the user how to use the past perfect tense to describe actions that were completed before a certain point in the past.

Name: Noun classifiers
Purpose: Teach common classifiers used with numbers and demonstratives, including which classifier naturally pairs with different nouns.

Name: Definite noun suffixes
Purpose: Teach Norwegian definite noun endings, gender and number agreement, and when a separate determiner is also required.

Name: Partitive articles
Purpose: Teach article and preposition forms used for unspecified quantities, especially with food, drink, and other mass nouns.

Name: Phrasal verbs
Purpose: Teach common English verb-particle combinations, separability, idiomatic meanings, register, and natural usage in context.

Name: Health
Purpose: Teach the user how to talk about health, fitness, and wellbeing, and give advice using modal verbs.

Name: Living Room
Purpose: Teach the user vocabulary and expressions related to the living room and its objects.

Name: Kitchen
Purpose: Teach the user vocabulary and expressions related to the kitchen and cooking.

Name: Household tasks
Purpose: Teach language for cleaning, organizing, repairs, chores, requests, and dividing household responsibilities.

Name: Animals
Purpose: Teach the user vocabulary for common animals and basic animal-related actions.

Name: Weather
Purpose: Teach the user vocabulary for common weather conditions and expressions for discussing the weather.

Name: Nature
Purpose: Teach the user vocabulary for talking about nature, landscapes, and outdoor activities.

Name: Lexical tones
Purpose: Teach learners to hear and produce lexical tone contrasts, understand tone marks or contours, and avoid meaning-changing tone errors.

Name: Sports
Purpose: Teach the user vocabulary and expressions related to sports, physical activities, and games.

Name: Introductions
Purpose: Teach the user how to introduce themselves and ask others' names in social situations.

Name: Family
Purpose: Teach the user words for family members, usage in social gatherings, family relationships, and ways to discuss family history.

Name: Romance and dating
Purpose: Teach respectful language for attraction, dating, partners, invitations, affection, boundaries, and relationship status.

Name: Geography
Purpose: Teach the user about geographical features, locations, and how to describe them.

Name: History
Purpose: Teach the user how to talk about historical events and periods, and use the past tense to describe them.

Name: Politics
Purpose: Introduce the user to political vocabulary, concepts, and the language used in political discussions.

Name: Science
Purpose: Introduce the user to basic scientific vocabulary, concepts, and the language used in scientific contexts.

Name: Philosophy
Purpose: Introduce the user to philosophical vocabulary, concepts, and the language used in philosophical discussions.

Name: Directions / where
Purpose: Teach the user how to ask for and give directions, and the vocabulary for describing locations.

Name: Transport
Purpose: Teach the user vocabulary and expressions related to different modes of transport and travel activities.

Name: Travel
Purpose: Teach the user how to plan and describe journeys, including future travel plans.

Name: Work
Purpose: Teach the user vocabulary and expressions common in work contexts, and how to describe their job and responsibilities.
